recipes.name: Chicken Broccoli Pot Pie
ingredients_raw: 1 (14.1 ounce) package double-crust pie pastry, thawed
2 boneless chicken breast halves, cooked and chopped
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line the bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate with one pie crust. Set second crust aside.

Place a steamer insert into a saucepan and fill with water to just below the bottom of the steamer. Bring water to a boil. Add broccoli and carrots, cover, and steam until tender but still firm, about 2 to 3 minutes.

Mix cooked broccoli and carrots, chicken, condensed soup, cheese, milk, and salt together in a large bowl; spoon mixture into prepared pie crust. Cover filling with remaining pie crust; flute the edges to seal, then cut several slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake in preheated oven until crust is golden brown, about 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Chicken Broccoli Pot Pie
raw_recipe.description: This chicken broccoli pot pie has a creamy filling with chunks of cooked chicken, fresh broccoli, and Cheddar for a winning combination of flavors.

review.reviewBody: Excellent! I baked it at 425 for 30 mins and it turned out great. To keep the bottom crust from being soggy I pierced it with a fork several times and baked it in the oven a few minutes before adding the filling. I brushed an egg wash on top and it was golden brown. I also added lemon pepper, garlic powder, a bit more salt and fresh ground pepper to the filling or it would have been a little bland.

Overall a very tasty recipe! I made the following changes: 1) Used two carrots, cut into coins, and boiled until tender 2) Used frozen chopped broccoli 3) Used 1/2 and 1/2 in place of milk 4) Added basil and a chopped onion to the chicken while cooking 5) Added extra cheese 6) Baked the crust for 7 minutes before filling with mixture (pricked crust with fork first) 7) Baked at 375 intead of 425 for 40 mintues

Quick and yummy! Totally changed this recipe. Can I still review? Lol 9 months pregnant and totally over slaving over the stove. Mixed together 1/2 a bag of Tyson's Grilled and Ready Cubed Chicken (cooked in microwave first), 1/2 can of mixed peas and carrots, 1/2 can of corn, 1/2 small onion, 1 stalk of celery, used 1 can of Cream of Potato rather than the cream of chicken, 2/3 cup of milk, added the cheese, and seasoned to my liking with garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, pepper, and seasoned salt. Simmered for thickening and taste testing purposes before filling the crust. =) Baked at 425 for 30 minutes. Turned out so so good! Crust was great. Both my 4 year old picky princess and my Honey loved it.

I love this recipe! I've made it many times and only changed up the veggies that go in it, but I still love the broccoli in this pie. I use pre-cooked chicken strips or buy a roaster and cut off some chicken. I steam the broccoli in 5 minutes. I add a little extra cheese (because why not!). When working at home, I can put this together in 10-15 minutes, keep in frig till my hubby gets home, and pop it into the oven when he's ready to eat. I'm a comfort food girl and this totally fits the bill!!! Thanks so much for this recipe!

Delicious! I made this with baby carrots, broccoli, onion, and celery. Baked the bottom dough for about 7 minutes first so it wouldn’t be soggy then added the ingredients. I added extra cheese, some onion and garlic powder, and thyme. Love this recipe because you can use whatever vegetables you prefer. Baked in the oven at 400 for about 40 minutes. It was so good! Will definitely make again!

Pretty good base recipe. I used a frozen Pilsbury crust for the bottom, then whipped up a top crust made of 1/2 c. Bisquick, 1/4 stick of butter, and 1 tbsp. of water. I rolled that out on top of flour dusting with a flour-coated rolling pin then topped the pie with it. 

Really, you could use any veggies you want. I used what we had on hand: celery, a diced small potato (boiled about 10 minutes), cut carrots (boiled for a bit with the potatoes), garlic, and a cut zucchini. 

The only drawback I see is that the condensed soup makes it fairly salty...it would be nice to do the recipe where you made your filling completely from scratch.

This is one of those recipes that you always need on standby when you have leftovers... just chop up veggies or dump the bag stuff in a bowl and go for it. You can vary it as little or as much... I used leftover chicken tenders and fresh veggies. I took the advice of one reviewer and topped it with bisquik mix. Lowered it to 325 in a convection and cooked away... awesome.

After looking at other reviews, I made several additions to this recipe. I added 1 baked potato, 1 celery stalk, an extra can of soup, and 3-4 T of melted butter to the sauce. I added some pepper and garlic salt. I baked the crusts alone for a few minutes before filling. Baked at 375 for 45 min. We loved it and I will definitely make it again!

Adding a little fresh tarragon, rosemary and sage leftover from thanksgiving made this recipe 5 stars. I added half a can of cream of mushroom and additional salt was NOT needed. I also prebaked my pie crust. I suggest altering this recipe to serve your tastes and to use up whatever veggies available. I used cooked turkey breast. My hubby and son gobbled it up. Husband really liked the broccoli.

I changed this recipe up quite a bit, that is why I gave it only 4 stars. My hubby said it was definitely one of his favorites. 
Using refrigerated pie crusts, I filled the inside with fresh broccoli (steamed), grated carrots, steamed chunks of sweet potato (basically cooked in the microwave w/ water until soft),corn, onion, garlic, and cooked turkey breast I had marinated in s&p, broth & worchestershire sauce.
I then had a can of cream of chicken AND cream of onion, and about a 1/2 cup of milk. 
Poured it all into the pie crust that I flash baked for 10 min, at 350 degrees. I had extra filling so I froze that and will use it again another day. 
This turned out really flavorful and rich. Since the soups were not diluted, they were almost TOO strong. But the taste test came out great!! Definitely something I will make again. 
PS I didn't add any cheese and you would not miss the cheese at ALL!!!!

This is crazytown delicious. I made the following changes, all of which turned out great - 1) Baked the bottom layer of the crust in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes before filling. I used a premade crust and it worked just fine. 2) Didn't precook the chicken. I just put it in the pie raw. This worked great and saved time/cleaning. It cooked just fine in the pie. 3) Used a Kraft mild/sharp/white cheddar shredded cheese mix. 4) Baked at 400, not 425. This turned out GREAT. It was a little salty, but that could easily be remedied by cutting down on the 1/2 tsp salt. I've been looking for a pot pie recipe that I could make "mine" for a long time. Looks like I've found it!
Perfect ✨️✨️

Nice idea but ruined by the canned soup. I used homemade chicken broth and rotisserie chicken. I added flour and condensed milk to make my gravey. I added mushooms,a bit of nutmeg,fresh for the broccoli and about a cup of frozen mixed vegetables for more color and flavor. You can add whatever herbs and spices you want but my go to mix includes marjoram and thyme. Salt and pepper of course and bake and serve. Works for us.

This turned out great and my boyfriend and I really enjoyed it. The only change up I did was I used 4 chicken thighs instead of breasts and I put in some roasted mushrooms. It was delicious. I will certainly make this recipe again!n Thanks!

We’re not huge broccoli fans, so I did cut that back and filled in with other miscellaneous veggies. The recipe really should specify weight on the chicken, but FYI, I used 12 oz, and that worked out pretty well. I did add some garlic powder, black pepper, and bumped up the amount of salt a bit. I was a little concerned that the 2/3 cup milk might lead to a runny texture, but the filling consistency was spot on. We enjoyed this pot pie, and I’d make again.

Really tasty and really easy to make! I cooked the veggies for 0 minutes in a basket in my Instant Pot while I was cooking the chicken and that worked well. The only change I made to the recipe was to add a bit of garlic powder and pepper. I’d definitely make this one again.
I followed this recipe as is except for adding some steamed broccoli and it was absolutely delicious!
Delicious! I made it without the top crust. I added table cream and Parmesan cheese and it was amazing.
This is a great recipe. I reduced the amount of broccoli by half and added mixed vegetables instead of carrots. Delicious!
It's my family's favorite. I've made it many times. Sometimes I substitute potatoes for carrots or broccoli when I'm out of one. Very delicious pie!
